log: LOOP 197  IS THERE A PUBLIC SERIES DENSE ENOUGH TO REPLICATE THE ACCESSIBILITY CLOCK?
PREDECLARED: qualifying means >= 8 timepoints carrying BOTH an accessibility
assay and RNA, in ONE cell system, spanning at most 24 hours -- four
is measured too few (loops 192, 196), the A549 series that works has eleven, and an
hour-scale effect cannot be resolved over days however many points there are. The
ENCODE query is BROADENED beyond loop 192's treatment-duration filter, which could not
see a differentiation series. Y1 checks the query can find A549 before any absence is
believed. The GEO arm is a shortlist and says so: its timepoints live in prose and
parsing a count out of prose would give it standing it has not earned.
Y1 CAN THE SEARCH FIND WHAT IT IS LOOKING FOR?
5,792 released human accessibility/RNA experiments returned

Y4 IS THE CLOCK REPLICABLE WITH PUBLIC DATA?

Y4 FAIL -- and this is the finding. No structured public series other than A549 is dense enough. The GEO shortlist may contain one, but that cannot be established from metadata and needs a per-series check
Y5 THE CAVEAT IS WRITTEN EITHER WAY
wrote NOTES_accessibility_clock_status.md
Y5 PASS -- NOTES_accessibility_clock_status.md records what is measured, what is not established, and how the number must be quoted
Y6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
An absence in a structured archive is not an absence in the literature. ENCODE models
time in three fields and this loop reads all three, but a series that records its
grid only in a description is invisible to it and would be invisible to any query.
The 8-point threshold is a guess placed between the 4 that is measured to fail and
the 11 that works. Nothing here establishes that 8 is sufficient -- a candidate found
at 8 would still have to pass loop 192's W3 calibration before being believed.
The GEO arm ranks by sample count, which is not timepoint count. A 200-sample series
may be one timepoint across many conditions.
This loop searched human data only. A dense mouse series would be a weaker but real
test and is not considered here.
